name: Do I need permits for exterior stonework in the DFW area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for exterior stonework in the DFW area?

acceptedAnswer.text: For significant exterior stonework projects that alter the structural integrity or significantly change the exterior appearance of a building, local building codes in DFW municipalities, such as Dallas or Fort Worth, may require permits. Minor cosmetic changes typically do not. As a first-party insight, we often help homeowners navigate these requirements by assessing the project's scope during the initial consultation and advising on potential permit needs to ensure compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits may be required for significant exterior stonework changes in DFW, depending on local codes. We can advise during consultation.
